materialized.name: Mapping screen architecture
materialized.description: User-supplied Mapping UI tree with deliberately partial implementation mappings.

codeEntities.label: MappingScreen
codeEntities.summary: Loads project representations, retains document drafts, and composes the Mapping screen.

codeEntities.label: MappingSubmenu
codeEntities.summary: Displays the project, editable name, creation/save actions, and status.

codeEntities.label: NewDiagramAction
codeEntities.summary: Creates a canvas from entered ASCII or a copy of the active document.

codeEntities.label: SaveDiagramAction
codeEntities.summary: Saves a captured draft against its expected project revision.

codeEntities.label: CanvasViewport
codeEntities.summary: Controls canvas pan, zoom, recentering, pointer gestures, and focus.

codeEntities.label: CenterAndReset
codeEntities.summary: Computes a centered transform with an inset for the explorer.

codeEntities.label: GridBox
codeEntities.summary: Recursive discriminated union of diagram boxes and container boxes.

codeEntities.label: Scene
codeEntities.summary: Resolves recursive box sizes, positions, collapsed content, and absolute bounds.

codeEntities.label: SelectionInteraction
codeEntities.summary: Converts the completed drag to a rectangle and selects intersecting mapped labels.

codeEntities.label: GenerateSubDiagram
codeEntities.summary: Generates ASCII for a requested region, inserts a diagram, and settles its layout.

codeEntities.label: PromptSelection
codeEntities.summary: Applies a source-backed edit or begins sub-diagram placement.

codeEntities.label: ProjectionCompanion
codeEntities.summary: Renders the enclosing projection panel, header controls, and call-tree or source-compaction body.

codeEntities.label: ProjectedCallTree
codeEntities.summary: OR-matches evidence, expands matched subtrees, and adds ancestors for display.

codeEntities.label: ProjectedSourceCompactions
codeEntities.summary: Projects exact compaction rows with ancestors, excluding unrelated descendants.

codeEntities.label: LocalConversation
codeEntities.summary: Renders the transcript, pending/error state, verbosity control, and follow-up composer.

codeEntities.label: ProjectExplorer
codeEntities.summary: Filters project diagrams and renders the active canvas box hierarchy.
